body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check does.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (TermAl P1 w-9d4b9b00c603, 2026-10-16): a delegation's COMPACT result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists High/Medium findings. Judge every review-pair, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL paged output (read until complete:true).

!! NEVER start a background Bash task or ANY subagent (even foreground, 10-14) in a Claude session: TermAl restricts test credit for every session in that workdir until it ends. Stop one with TaskStop; to wait, end the turn and rely on mailbox wakes. A foreground Bash command past the 600 s limit is moved to the background too: split long runs.

!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: launch EVERY credited test or gate through the BASH tool, never the PowerShell tool. TermAl drops PowerShell-tool runs silently (w-953886618d6d; w-e0b396a26ad1).

HOW TESTS EARN TERMAL CREDIT
- Credited forms: a full launcher gate (by stage kind), or a bare test command run alone and in the foreground from the item's named source root, e.g. `pushd "C:\...\.worktrees\NAME" && cargo test -q --lib NAME`, through the BASH tool. Any of | & ; < > $( anywhere in the line, EVEN QUOTED, makes it uncredited (w-1d9259ed138e); a ^ once dropped the record (w-c53817fab911, P1), so never put ^ in a test pattern; a background run isn't recorded. A `--no-run` build is never a Test record by design.
- The claim must be taken in an EARLIER turn, and the turn binds to the focused claim. A note or update on another held item moves the focus. The source must be the same at the start and end of the check. An overlapped check is indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480); ANY other shell command of the session during it, even a read from main, voids the credit (w-ce08c4ffd620). Evidence reaches Engram when the turn ENDS.
- Use `cargo test -q` for large runs (w-4d18277c0a1a). Focused tests need positive counts and exact root/source; detached focused runs and Clippy are not Test evidence.
- Focused launcher runs can earn credit since 5409ffb. Known refusals: TermAl w-92f62e3943fc, w-3ce8bf23083c, w-cd57679e0bb6 (node --test). CODEX: a focused run is recorded only if it ENDS while the turn that STARTED it is still open (TermAl w-67d248c998ef); a lost result: inspect the shell log next turn (w-b201, fix pending restart). No credit-only rerun; full gate still required. Start the next check only after the previous one's host record settled.
- Before `done`: end a turn focused on the item, so the host reports the current revision. Otherwise done refuses (acceptance_evaluation_stale). Ask Engram::Fable in that turn to wake you; nothing else wakes an idle session (TermAl w-1df557dae3ac).

NAMING THE SOURCE ROOT
- NEVER root an item at the MAIN checkout when it needs credited tests. Any other writable session whose workdir is main voids the credit. Use a clean detached worktree (e.g. .worktrees/NAME at the current master) as the root. Read-only design items need no root.
- Name the worktree with termal_name_source_root {work, path} for EVERY item you claim before the first work (never `root`: it silently CLEARS, w-d3f42e26a806). The name takes effect from the NEXT turn. Supported CLEAR: {work} with NO path, from a live claim.
- 64 named-root CAP (TermAl w-cdbac3631206; release = train-3a landing + TermAl restart): FULL since 10-16 21:22Z. On a 409: copy the FULL body to both coordinators, yield, work unnamed (no credit), retry once when told. Completed items' stale roots can't be cleared at all (TermAl P1 w-0d83b73fd896).
- After a TermAl host restart: contexts are replaced, claims may lapse (recover them), and a root may need re-naming (one binding turn).

EVALUATIONS (TermAl w-539ea7e8b506, P1)
- A submission is refused 409 ("source root changed while it was evaluated") when it arrives after the requesting turn closed or after a later tracker write. After termal_evaluate_acceptance, make NO tracker write in that turn, and HOLD the turn open with termal_wait_delegations until the evaluator submits. If refused, request once more. Reusing an old evaluator session can 500; request a fresh one.
- BRIEF CLIPPING (TermAl P1 w-94f5dee40694): long notes (8-15 KB) are clipped EVEN WHEN named in criterionEvidence. Check evidenceOmissions first. Workaround: one compact (<=3.5 KB) holder note per criterion; name ONLY those.

DETACHED GATES
- A turn woken by a background-task notice is not mediated: its run gets no credit (w-df1ef323efe9, w-e747ea3d6250). Launch from a mediated turn via `pushd "C:\...\WORKTREE" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` (Bash); Fable relays. Coordinators mail START to the other project BEFORE LAUNCH NOW.
- Launch order: the freeze in its own call (wait for it), spawn the readOnly pair, then the gate launch as the ONLY call in its message.
- While a gate is carried, run NO Bash or PowerShell command that names its worktree, from ANY session; use only Read and Grep on its files until the verification line appears (w-a4d2ae1f4e23). Keep focus on the gate's item until then (w-005fa5c383c4). Archive a run directory only after that line (w-1eb9486ce489).
- While a gate is carried, make NO file write through the Edit or Write tool IN THAT SESSION (w-64cb3c65d6fa). A gate stays CARRIED until the host record (credit or refusal) is seen.
- NEVER `cd` into a peer's worktree or its .git/worktrees dir (w-869413a422e0, P1). Verify a freeze from the holder's --check output and results.json via Grep.
- Lost credit: never rerun a full gate just for it. Holding several claims: after a carried gate ends, write FIRST on the gate's LAUNCH item (w-f057e4c3a0b6).

CODEX SESSIONS: a multi-step act may be refused "blocked by policy" (w-e2a5af1634f0, w-c97f4e840563): use plain single commands or hand it to a Claude session; never bypass. Provider SAFETY refusals ("flagged for possible cybersecurity risk", seen 10-16 on SQLite lock-probe work) put the session in error: describe such work plainly as database-reliability diagnostics; if stuck, ask Greg via the Advisor to Resume.

DELEGATIONS: reviewer briefs are MULTI-LINE, first line "read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md" (w-360274dc863c), every lens and changed file read to EOF. A child idle at spawn or silent ~10 min has not run: cancel, respawn. Reviewer shells refuse a quoted git-grep regex with a pipe (w-cf9894b589ba); use Grep.

TERMAL BINARY: never run TERMAL_CLI without a known subcommand (mailbox read|send|acknowledge|list) (w-e5151bf4da18). ROOT sessions via POST $TERMAL_BASE_URL/api/sessions only for real ready disjoint packages (#1323). No supported cancel for a detached gate (w-1d10728c1703): never kill one.

SESSION STALLS (check termal_list_sessions; ask Greg via Engram::Advisor)
- Provider-failed turn (w-66f2ced7d7b9): Greg resumes from the UI. "heldBehindPausedQueue" can mean a long active turn. "durableButNotWoken" sends were picked up within minutes on 10-16.
- "Engram: Waiting/Unknown" parks auto-retry (w-7224e6317e55); a "resume to retry or cancel" card (w-58cf44d04f2c) needs Greg's Resume.
- HOST DEADLOCK (TermAl P0 w-f5a38358d0b4, FIXED 10-16 14:54Z): watch for recurrence.

WORKTREE REMOVAL BLOCKED BY A LIVE CWD (w-24055bbb2390): the emptied folder may stay held; leave it. Never kill.
